title: Unit Event — Lead to Shine More — Episode5 My Answer

meta.Event Outline: With more work offers coming in for MORE MORE JUMP! than they can fulfill, Haruka and the others have a serious talk about their work priorities moving forward.

rows.Line: The next day
MORE MORE HOUSE

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Okay, that's everything regarding your schedules for this week.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Thank you, Saito.
Then, next...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Thank you all for your patience.
But I was able to make use of the time you gave me to find a satisfactory answer.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Really?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, let's hear it.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Okay.
Like I said before, I don't think there's anything wrong with what you all said, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I also believe that we should think about how we're going to spread hope to others when choosing which offers to accept...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And we're also going to need more media exposure in order to increase our name recognition and make our dream a reality.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I believe there's another important factor that we need to consider.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I believe we need to show everyone what makes MORE MORE JUMP! special.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What makes us special, huh...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: To be transparent, I'm borrowing something that the producer for ASRUN said to me when I was still with them. You see...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Now I see...
If we win fans with what makes us unique, then we'll really be their one and only.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And that staunch base of supporters cheering us on will give us the energy we need, while also helping bring in more fans...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Exactly. Yes, increasing our name recognition is important...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But we also need to make sure they see what makes us special.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I agree, but...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What exactly is it that makes us special?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I think the answer to that is...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We're idols who are just ourselves.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Just ourselves?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I feel that's sort of where we've landed.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: For example, Shizuku, you're always doing your best to make sure the audience enjoys what they see.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Airi, you work harder than anyone else to cheer people up and make them laugh.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori, you... You've never given up on your dream. No matter how many obstacles you run into, you just keep going.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
That's what I love about all of you.
That's what I think our fans love about us. We're just ourselves.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And I feel that they've been able to see that because we've been doing streams as freelancers in particular.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Of course, that's resulted in us running into some problems that we couldn't solve on our own.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But I believe that working together and helping each other out during times of need is a cornerstone of MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Yes, I know exactly what you mean!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: This is just my opinion as a fan, but I feel that all of you in MMJ treat us as equals.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Even when you're streaming, you don't feel like celebrities living in a different world. You make us feel at home. Almost like we're family.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Which is why I think just watching you all helps us so much when we're feeling down or upset. It's like you're right there cheering us on.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: And seeing you all do your absolute best makes us want to do the same.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Saito...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So... We've been able to spread hope to others because we've been able to interact with them on a personal level?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. I really hope that's true!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, same here.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Then, let's use what Haruka said as one of the criteria for us choosing which offers to accept. Whether or not we'll be able to show everyone what it is that makes us special!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: In that case, which offers would be best?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Well, instead of things that would require us to stick to a certain script or theme, we may want to place a priority on offers that allow us to just be ourselves.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: For instance, shows with longer talk segments or close-coverage reporting should give us opportunities to show everyone who we really are.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: In that case, I'll try picking out offers which align with all the criteria you've set.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: I've had a chance to review everything, and the offers that cover the criteria we just discussed include...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: “Funtime Lunchtime,” which is a variety show, and “The Town Revitalization Team!” They shoot documentaries about the namesake subject.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Right. Both seem like they'll give us plenty of opportunities to spread hope to our viewers, cheer them up and make them smile...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: “The Town Revitalization Team!” is run by a regional station, but it's supposed to be very popular. Both should give us the exposure we need.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Right. Now, for each program's content...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: “The Town Revitalization Team!” covers all the criteria we've listed, since their goal is to shoot “real documentaries about real people.” Nothing is staged.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I can't say 100% for “Funtime Lunchtime,” but a lot of those competition-type variety shows have scripts that are really just an agenda with a list of activities. That format could also work for us.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Then, I'd like for you all to choose from these two.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: My instincts are telling me that “Funtime Lunchtime” is the way to go.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: “The Town Revitalization Team!” is a segment of a popular program, but we'd be working with a narrower demographic. Also, it looks like it's only available on certain apps.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: “Funtime Lunchtime” has a wider audience, which means more exposure for us.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm voting for “The Town Revitalization Team!”

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: They shoot for extended periods without using scripts, and we'd get to interact closely with the locals as we try to bring their town back to life, right?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Our strengths and our shortcomings will all show up as-is. To other idols, that could be a considerable risk...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But that's what makes this program perfect for us. We'd have far more freedom to just be ourselves than on “Funtime Lunchtime.”

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, it's not as well-known, but I really want to put who we are at the forefront here.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: How does that sound, everyone?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Then, let's go with that!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Airi...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I like what you just said, Haruka!
Let's go out there and really show everyone who we are!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I agree. I also really like what you just said, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thanks. Then...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah!
“The Town Revitalization Team!” it is!
A few weeks later
Town of Hanamioka

rows.Speaker: Crew Member
rows.Line: Hey, carry that equipment over too while you're at it!

rows.Speaker: Crew Member
rows.Line: Got it! Up you go...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We finally get to start shooting today!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. I am a little bit nervous, but let's all do our best for the people of Hanamioka.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah!
TV Station

rows.Speaker: Show Director
rows.Line: Alright, let me give you all another brief rundown of this program.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Yes, please do.

rows.Speaker: Show Director
rows.Line: “The Town Revitalization Team!” is a segment of our show which involves helping towns that ask us to assist in breathing new life into them.

rows.Speaker: Show Director
rows.Line: We'll be visiting the town of Hanamioka this time around. It has a population of 6,000, so it's quite small. And you ladies will be helping us with...

rows.Speaker: Show Director
rows.Line: As I mentioned early in our talks, the town marathon.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm sorry, but would it be alright if I asked why the town marathon?

rows.Speaker: Show Director
rows.Line: Of course. Hanamioka isn't famous for producing anything in particular, but it's overflowing with natural beauty.

rows.Speaker: Show Director
rows.Line: The marathon's course is meant to introduce people to the area's charm and spectacular scenery.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Show Director
rows.Line: Unfortunately, they've been struggling to get more people to sign up. With that and a staffing shortage, they decided to ask us for help with their revitalization efforts.

rows.Speaker: Show Director
rows.Line:
Naturally, you'll be helping run things on the day of.
But we'll also need you to help come up with ideas to liven things up, and get everything prepared.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
We had no idea...
Of course, we'll do everything we can to help.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We've never helped out with a marathon before, but we promise to do what we can for all of Hanamioka's locals!

rows.Speaker: Show Director
rows.Line: Yes, thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Show Director
rows.Line: Obviously, my job is to create content that our viewers will enjoy, but I also want what I do to help people whose homes are struggling.

rows.Speaker: Show Director
rows.Line: This show's been able to go on for as long as it has because the locals have been so helpful and supportive.

rows.Speaker: Show Director
rows.Line: So, I hope you'll sincerely think about Hanamioka and the people who live there during your time with us.

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: We will!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I was honestly a little surprised when I heard that we'd be helping with the town marathon...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That being said, let's all do our best to shine a light on what makes this place so special!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, let's.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(Also...
We need to show everyone what makes us special, too.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (If we can do that, it'll be the quickest way to move towards realizing our dream.)
se_run_women_003_1

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
Everyone!
They said they're ready to start shooting, so let's start heading over!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, okay!
